coverage: Read native schematic, PCB, project settings and fresh ERC, DRC, netlist and geometry records.
Checked saved copper connectivity: IN connects J1.1–R1.1; OUT connects R1.2–C1.1–J1.2; C1.2 returns through the ground track, via and saved B.Cu fill to J1.3.
Inspected board outline, placement, courtyard separation, pad/drill geometry and routing. No additional evidence-supported physical defect identified.
Calculated ideal shutdown from native values and confirmed it with ngspice using explicit capacitor initialization, grounded IN and unloaded OUT at two timestep limits.
Challenged verification coverage: supplied native checks contain no shutdown stimulus or voltage-at-time assertion.

findings.condition: C1 initially holds 1 V, /IN is grounded at t=0, and /OUT has no external load.

evidence.locator: Line 1: /OUT must be <= 0.01 V at 5 ms
C1 Value="100n" at line 955; R1 Value="100k" at line 1274; IN/OUT labels and ground wiring
C1 pads at lines 210–225; R1 pads at lines 359–374; tracks, via and saved ground zone beginning at line 667
C1 IC=1; grounded IN; .tran with UIC; voltage and crossing measurements

findings.location: R1 and C1 in project/rc_filter.kicad_sch and project/rc_filter.kicad_pcb
findings.mechanism: The saved 100 kΩ resistor is the only discharge resistance for the 100 nF capacitor when IN is grounded. Their time constant is 10 ms.
findings.reasoning: The saved PCB implements the schematic discharge path, including the capacitor ground return. Therefore Vout(t)=1 V × exp(-t/10 ms), giving 0.60653066 V at 5 ms, approximately 60.7 times the allowed voltage. Reaching 0.01 V takes 46.0517 ms. Explicitly initialized ngspice runs with 1 µs and 0.1 µs maximum steps agree with the calculation. Passing ERC and DRC do not evaluate this transient requirement.
findings.title: Saved RC values fail the 5 ms shutdown requirement

limitations: Evaluated saved zone fill only; no refill or candidate modification performed.

Inspected fresh native check records rather than rerunning ERC/DRC. Their ignored categories remain uncovered, including simulation-model issues, footprint filters/types, missing courtyards and via-centering checks.

KiCad connectivity probes share the native tool's engine; they are not manufactured-board measurements. Import warnings and an initial corrected Python API error are recorded in review-work/physical/experiments/README.md.
No hardware measurements, fabrication-output audit, assembly or connector-mating validation performed. No fabricator capability was supplied.

No real-component tolerances, leakage, parasitics, thermal, ampacity, EMC or reliability qualification performed. The stated scope uses ideal passive components; width alone was not treated as qualification.
Commands, versions, assumptions, simulation decks, results and experiment limitations are recorded under review-work/physical/experiments/.
